question: Simplify:(sec(x) - tan(x))/(sec(x) + tan(x))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert **sec(x)** and **tan(x)** into **sin(x)** and **cos(x)** forms mentally.

Since both **sec(x) = 1/cos(x)** and **tan(x) = sin(x)/cos(x)** share the same denominator **cos(x)**, it cancels out from both the numerator and denominator of the main fraction.

Resulting expression = (1 − sin(x)) / (1 + sin(x)).

**∴ The correct answer is ((1 − sin(x))) / ((1 + sin(x))).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (sec(x) − tan(x)) / (sec(x) + tan(x))

**Formula Used:** **sec(x) = 1/cos(x)** and **tan(x) = sin(x)/cos(x)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5065b3c6c413ddaf1256afe1dc77b3178231010e6258a17e0dfb7096ba73f58f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ [(1/cos(x)) − (sin(x)/cos(x))] / [(1/cos(x)) + (sin(x)/cos(x))]

⇒ [ (1 − sin(x)) / cos(x) ] / [ (1 + sin(x)) / cos(x) ]

⇒ [ (1 − sin(x)) / cos(x) ] × [ cos(x) / (1 + sin(x)) ]

⇒ (1 − sin(x)) / (1 + sin(x))

This expression matches the simplified form given in **Option 2**.

**∴ The correct answer is ((1 − sin(x))) / ((1 + sin(x))).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identity

One of the most used identities is **sec²(x) − tan²(x) = 1**, which implies **(sec(x) − tan(x)) = 1 / (sec(x) + tan(x))**.

Reciprocal Identities

**sec(x) = 1/cos(x)**, **cosec(x) = 1/sin(x)**, and **cot(x) = 1/tan(x) = cos(x)/sin(x)** are essential for simplifying rational trigonometric expressions.

Alternative Rationalization

Multiplying both numerator and denominator by **(sec(x) − tan(x))** transforms the expression into **(sec(x) − tan(x))²**, which can further be expanded or simplified based on the requirements.</p
